itinerary.title: Arrive, settle in, meet the lake
itinerary.description: Transfer to your Srinagar base and settle in without a long sightseeing list. With a suitable arrival time, request a gentle lake-side pause around Hazratbal, following current visiting guidance. A late arrival means rest and a welcome meal instead. Talk through your interests with the coordinator so the next two days focus on the history, faith, craft or everyday life that interests you most.

experiences: A welcome conversation about your interests and walking pace
An optional lakeside tea pause, separately agreed

itinerary.title: Shrines, timber courtyards and the bazaar
itinerary.place: Khanqah-e-Moula · Zaina Kadal · Maharaj Gunj · Jamia Masjid
itinerary.description: Give the old city its own day. Begin near Khanqah-e-Moula and follow a guide-selected route through the bridge-side lanes and market area towards Jamia Masjid and Nowhatta. Look at architecture, pause for the stories behind the streets, and leave time for copperware browsing or a bakery stop. Prayer and current access decide whether religious interiors can be visited. Request a shorter walk or vehicle link if the complete circuit does not suit your group.

itinerary.title: Museum objects and the maker’s hands
itinerary.place: SPS Museum · one appointed artisan visit
itinerary.description: Begin with the SPS Museum at Lal Mandi when its opening schedule allows, then travel to one craft appointment chosen in advance. A carpet loom, pashmina weaving, papier-mâché painting, sozni embroidery or walnut carving can be the focus, depending on a willing host. Agree whether the visit is observation or a paid hands-on session. Keep the rest of the day relaxed; a Polo View browse is optional, and all listed crafts are not promised in a single afternoon.

itinerary.title: A final Srinagar morning
itinerary.description: Keep your final morning aligned with the airport or onward transfer. Have breakfast if timing allows and leave an adequate traffic and security buffer. Guests who want a separate multi-faith day around Hazratbal, Chatti Padshahi or the Hari Parbat area can request an additional night; those visits are not squeezed into departure morning.
